title.native: 世界最強の魔女、始めました

synonyms: Sekai Saikyou no Majo, Hajimemashita: Watashi dake "Kouryaku Site" wo Mireru Sekai de Jiyuu ni Ikimasu
世界最強の魔女、始めました　～私だけ『攻略サイト』を見れる世界で自由に生きます～
description:
After using her SSS-Rank skill, Internet, to crush her former family’s ambitions, Lorna is free to travel the world. Her next stop is the port town of Aquas, where she hopes to see the sights and chow down on some fresh seafood. But when she arrives, the place is on the brink of destruction thanks to a certain Weekly Quest… Good thing Lorna has the gods on her side!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

node.description:
Originally the daughter of the House of Gugrekass—a border-ruling noble family renowned for martial prowess—she was branded a "family disgrace" and banished with nothing but the clothes on her back after manifesting a "dud skill" during the appraisal ceremony; consequently, she adopted "Hermit"—her late mother's maiden name—as her own (a change reflected even in her status screen).

Although she had undergone magic training and could barely cast basic spells, she lacked a staff to amplify her magical power and had no practical combat experience; as a result, she was unable to inflict damage even on an Ipul Slime, a monster considered the weakest of them all.

However, upon discovering the true power and utility of her dud skill, she inadvertently rose to become the world's strongest witch.

name.native: エリミナ・マナフレイム

node.description:
She is the master of the Adventurer's Guild and bears the epithet "Witch of Incineration." While she possesses a strong sense of elitism, she also has a surprisingly fragile side... 

Though she is terrified after witnessing Lona's immense magical power, she finds herself repeatedly drawn into dealings with her.

An Elf princess. 

Worried about her ailing mother, she found herself in a perilous situation while searching for medicinal herbs but was rescued by Rona; she has since come to blindly revere Rona as the legendary "Savior." She is a pure, lovely girl who is a bit of an airhead and whose respect for Rona knows no bounds.

A young princess of the Water Dragon tribe who lives in an undersea kingdom. 

After Lona inadvertently performs a certain action, an exact duplicate of Lulu appears. The two Lulus constantly engage in lively squabbles, calling each other "impostor!"

name.native: アリエス・ティア・ブルームーン

node.description:
The guild master of the port town of Aquas. She is swamped with demanding duties and constantly plagued by the monsters that attack the town every Wednesday. 

Although she is a stunning beauty, she harbors a dangerous quirk: whenever she sees a cute young girl, she cannot suppress the "middle-aged man" lurking within her. She is the type who relieves stress by drinking.

name.native: ラインハルテ・ハイウィンド

node.description:
A young man who was once a highly skilled adventurer—known by the epithet "Swift as the Gale and Fierce as the Thunder"—but retired after taking an arrow to the knee.

He now works as a gatekeeper in a rural town, a role that also serves as a way to recuperate.
The spirit of the World Tree.
